name: Warrior
desc: At any time, you may exchange three Standard Strain for a single Persistent Strain, or Persistant Strain for Corruption.

name: Hero
desc: Your Critical Success Range increases for every Injury, and you have Resistence-1_All while Injured.

name: Immutable
desc: When you are Scraped, you can voluntarily suffer one Persistent Strain to negate any Injury Risk.

name: Champion
desc: Your Critical range is 1 greater and, when you Critically Succeed any Test, you shed one Strain. If you Critically succeed two or more in a row, you may shed one Persistent Strain instead.
